summary: A small trend line in the fill color, with no axes.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: What the line shows, for screen readers, such as "Revenue, rising".

props.name: width
props.description: The drawing's width in pixels. Without it, the line fills its container.

props.name: dot
props.description: A dot on the latest value.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.
